name: The Shifted Reference
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: encyclopedia cover illustration for Avarenne, a mature late-industrial occult fantasy novel. Scene: A late industrial calibration workbench, brass measuring rule and two distinct sets of old and new anchor marks on the stone floor, a technician comparing their alignment, subtle invested geometric glow confined to the rule; no warped room or floating furniture. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, tactile architecture and believable materials, dramatic but readable light, atmospheric depth. One coherent scene, landscape 3:2. Show only the specified bounded manifestation; supernatural graphic traces are illustrative, never game interface. Anonymous adult figures only when specified, no named canonical character. No legible text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, card frame or collage. No additional creature, portal, deity, avatar or city-wide catastrophe. Avoid exaggerating the effect beyond its local source.
visual_caption: Il confronto fra le marche vecchie e nuove distingue la misura certificata dalla posizione attuale. Ricostruzione illustrativa, non prova diagnostica o fonte di nuove capacità.
visual_review: APPROVATA: scena, limiti illustrativi e assenza di poteri aggiuntivi verificati
